question: For the bank, standalone, what gross NPA ratio did HDFC Bank report as of March 31, 2026?
notes: Stated in prose and the GNPA chart on p44, and in the highlight panels on p5 and p9. Distractors: FY25 bank GNPA of 1.33% (p44 chart), and subsidiary HDB Financial Services GNPA of 2.44% as on March 31, 2026 (p54). These pages call it the Bank's figure without printing the word 'standalone'; it sits alongside standalone PAT of ₹74,671 crore. Printed folios differ from file pages: p5='03', p9='07', p44='46'.

question: In HDFC Bank's FY2025-26 network breakdown by location, how many ATMs and cash recycler machines are in semi-urban areas?
notes: Row 'Semi-urban', column 'ATMs/CRMs' in the 'Our Pan India Presence' grid. The semi-urban split appears only on p37; the network total of 21,172 also appears on p9 and p84. Do not confuse with 3,213 semi-urban branches (p36-37). The table itself carries no date. Printed folio is also '37'.

question: What share of HDFC Bank's workforce was women in FY2025-26?
notes: On the p8 highlights panel, in the human-capital outcomes on p58 (value creation spread), and as the 'FY26 Performance' figure on the p75 DE&I materiality page. Total employees of 2,11,178 sit nearby on p8/p58. Printed folios: p8='06', p58='60', p75='78'.

question: How many privacy principles is HDFC Bank's data privacy programme built on under its privacy-by-design approach?
notes: p109 is a 3-column page; the sentence breaks across columns ('anchored on ten' ends column 2, 'defined privacy principles' starts column 3). p119 is 2-column ('10 privacy principles' is in the right-hand 'Ensuring Data Privacy' column). Printed folios: p109='112', p119='122'.

question: What was the size of HDFC Bank's standalone gold loan portfolio as of March 31, 2026?
notes: From the Gold Loans section of the Directors' Report. The page has 2 columns and the fact is in the left column (printed folio 270). The 34% YoY growth also appears on p255, but the ₹23,820 crore portfolio size appears only on p265.

question: In the consolidated accounts for FY2025-26, how much did HDB Financial Services contribute to the group's consolidated profit, both in rupee terms and as a share of the total?
answer: ₹2,458.73 crore, equal to 3.10% of consolidated profit
notes: Consolidated figure, from the profit columns of Annexure 3 to the Directors' Report (Schedule III additional information, printed folio 306). Do not confuse it with HDB's own profit after tax of ₹2,544 crore, which is stated on p280.

question: How many corruption incidents did HDFC Bank confirm during FY2025-26, and how many employees were involved in them?
notes: From the anti-corruption box in the corporate governance section, set as single-column text (printed folio 345). Of the 45 employees, 37 had already been dismissed or disciplined and action against 8 was still underway. Not a financial number. This part has no BRSR pages, so there is no brsr question.

question: For the bank, standalone, what was the total capital adequacy ratio under Basel III as at March 31, 2026?
answer: 19.71% (rounded to 19.7 per cent in the Directors' Report)
notes: Standalone figure. The Basel III table in Schedule 18 of the standalone financial statements gives 19.71% (p378, printed folio 383). The CAR section of the Directors' Report rounds it to 19.7 per cent (p253, printed folio 258). Distractor: the subsidiary HDB Financial Services reports a capital adequacy ratio of 21.40% on p280.

question: How many villages did HDFC Bank's rural footprint cover in FY2025-26?
notes: Two-column Directors' Report pages (Semi-Urban and Rural section). Page 263 says the footprint 'crossed the 2.5 lakh village milestone, covering more than 2.52 lakh villages'. Page 264 repeats 'over 2.52 lakh villages'. Printed page labels are 268 and 269.

question: How many permanent employees were on HDFC Bank's own rolls (the bank, standalone, excluding subsidiaries) as of March 31, 2026?
notes: This comes from Annexure 4 to the Directors' Report (Section 197 remuneration disclosure, item 4). The BRSR section itself is not in this file; the report's index puts it at printed page 560. The same page gives an 11.43% rise in median employee remuneration, which could act as a distractor. Printed page label is 308.

question: How many whistleblower complaints did HDFC Bank handle during FY2025-26?
notes: Page 287 (Directors' Report, vigil mechanism section) says 177 complaints were received and investigated, leading to staff action in 75 cases. Page 340 (Our Policies and Frameworks, single-column) says the Bank addressed 177 whistleblower complaints. Possible distractor: HDFC Life's 177 per cent solvency ratio on page 280. Printed page labels are 292 and 345.

question: On a consolidated basis, how much net capital reserve on consolidation did the HDFC Bank group carry at March 31, 2026, after netting off goodwill?
notes: Consolidated. Previous year ₹3,223.50 crore (goodwill ₹501.56 crore). Stated only on this page in the file. Printed page label: 535.

question: In the Schedule III entity-wise breakdown of the consolidated accounts, what profit did HDFC Bank Limited itself (the bank, standalone, shown as the parent) earn for FY2025-26, and what share of consolidated profit was that?
answer: ₹74,671.29 crore, which is 94.26% of consolidated profit
notes: Standalone parent-entity row, before inter-company adjustments. Distractors on the same page: consolidated total ₹79,219.46 crore (also shown on p540), HDB Financial Services ₹2,458.73 crore, HDFC AMC (Consolidated) ₹2,855.50 crore. FY2024-25 parent figure ₹67,347.36 crore is on p549. Printed page label: 553.

question: What were HDFC Bank's total Scope 2 greenhouse gas emissions for FY2025-26, as reported in its BRSR?
notes: BRSR is on a standalone basis (p556). Market-based method (stated on p592). FY2024-25: 2,84,877.91 tCO2e. Distractor on the same page: Scope 1 total 91,849.51 tCO2e. Printed page label: 596.

question: After the 1:1 bonus issue, how many American Depositary Shares did HDFC Bank have outstanding at March 31, 2026?
notes: Right-hand column of a 2-column page. The ADS count appears only on this page. The underlying 2,05,62,05,886 equity shares (13.36% of paid-up capital) also appear in tables on p613 and p614. Previous year: 34,27,00,981 ADS. Printed page label: 617.
